newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower, further falls seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower, further falls seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished lower on Wednesday on loosening liquidity and dealers expected further falls on Thursday.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.465 percent against Tuesday's 5.483 close, with the 30-day commercial paper at 5.30-5.35 percent against 5.35.

Dealers said short-term liquidity in the banking system was relatively loose as liquidity demand before the Chinese lunar New Year was lower than expected due to a slugglish domestic economy. The Chinese New Year falls on February 7.
The bond market reported no trade in the afternoon. But dealers said trading interest would likely focus on 86/4 government bonds on Thursday.
